5ca673e0d0bd6c2689c94ce3: Kid Danger rescues Bianca, and they share a kiss; Henry is upset when he realizes that Bianca kissed Kid Danger.
When Ray hears that Piper is going to Junior Anger Management to work on her anger issues, he makes a wager with Henry that he can make her lose her temper before the night ends.
When a dangerous piñata winds up at a child's birthday party, Kid Danger and Captain Man must go undercover to step in before it is too late.
Trouble follows Henry to his home when a rock from outer space turns out to be an egg with an alien creature inside it.
Henry and Charlotte discover things are not what they seem when Captain Man suddenly announces his plans to marry.
When Henry's dad gets an offer for a new job in Bordertown, Henry and Ray go undercover to try and stop him from getting the job and prevent Henry from having to move.
Lola realizes that double the cuteness could help her break into show business, so she teams up with Lily; Lori vows to make up for lost time in her senior year.
Lana and Lincoln enter to compete in a soap box derby; Luan must enroll in a culinary class.

Lincoln wishes he had 10 brothers instead of 10 sisters, and Lisa gives him a glimpse into that reality; Lola wants to be a part of the siblings' secrets club, but her siblings are reluctant to let in a tattle tale.

When the lights go out in the Loud House, the kids entertain themselves by taking turns telling parts of a story; Lucy and the Morticians' Club try to thwart plans for a school field trip to the beach.
Lynn pushes Liam to his limits when he becomes the star pitcher for the middle school baseball team; Lincoln's friends try to stop him from performing a magic act at the middle school talent show.
The siblings turn to Lisa's intelligence to help them land a spot on "Double Dare"; after secretly reading Luna's diary, Leni and Lincoln become worried about the exploits their sister writes about.

When the children hear Lily curse, they become worried that they have been a bad influence on her; when a love letter addressed to L. Loud arrives, the family tries to figure out who it was meant for.

After discovering he has rituals, Lincoln worries he's predictable and vows to change things up; Lori develops the yips when she finds out that the golf coach from her dream college is coming to see her play.

Lori takes a job as a waitress at Dad's restaurant, but it turns out that serving is harder than she anticipated; spurred on by a classmate's mocking about Charles, Lana decides to train him to compete in a local dog show.
Lisa gets invited to work at an institute and get away from her crazy family; Lori and Bobby worry that long-distance dating is causing them to lose their connection.
While on a field trip, Lincoln worries that his friend group is splintering; to buy her dream car, Lori becomes a local ride-share driver.
Lincoln begins to hog the spotlight when he becomes Luan's clown assistant; the Loud children have fun on a snow day.
Mr. Krabs turns the Krusty Krab into a hotel; SpongeBob's record of failed boating tests causes Mrs. Puff to lose her job.
Squidward turns SpongeBob and Patrick against each other; boat-driving exam.
Rock, Paper and Scissors want to take the perfect photo for their Christmas card but run into a problem; Paper and Scissors get into trouble by pretending to be someone else.

When his friends become obsessed with Rock's friend, Potato, Paper tries to win back their attention; when Rock, Scissors and Pencil learn that Paper dislikes fart jokes, they search for one that'll make him laugh.
Timmy, his father and the fairies get stuck in a board game created by Cosmo; Timmy wishes that Sparky would get a chance to be heroic.
Timmy tries to help the star of a superhero television show; Timmy accidentally releases a genie from a magic lava lamp.
Timmy and his fairies must save the city when Foop decides to make all of Dimmsdale unhappy by replacing everyone's pets with evil pets.
Timmy wishes himself doll-sized for an adventure with his action figure; Timmy's parents suspect he is shoplifting.

Timmy finds out that he has to share his fairies with the new girl in school, Chloe Carmichael, but when Chloe realizes she can use her magic for good, she wishes everyone in Dimmsdale would share everything, and chaos ensues.
Evil princess Mandie plots to marry Mark Chang and become ruler of Yugopotamia; Dark Laser offers Timmy a scholarship to Dark Mouth University in order to turn him into his evil apprentice.
Timmy wishes he could do the opposite of what his parents tell him; Timmy wishes for the body of a teenager.
Timmy wishes that Sparky could become human; Timmy wishes that Mr. Crocker would disappear, and Mr. Crocker becomes invisible.
Timmy borrows Mark Chang's Fake-i-fier in order to attend Trixie's costume party; Cosmo must enforce the rules when Jorgen comes down with the Trick-ups.
Crocker tries to trigger Sparky with a secret word; Catman confuses Sparky with his arch-nemesis, Dogman.
Timmy wishes his life was like an action movie; Timmy turns into a genius just in time to take a test.

When Catman thinks Timmy has been kidnapped, he mistakes Chloe for Catgirl and enlists her help to save Timmy; when Timmy wishes that his father could be Mayor, he ends up getting tortured by the paparazzi and risks having his fairies discovered.
Timmy's parents find Poof and are convinced that he is an alien super baby; Jorgen takes Timmy to a rehabilitation facility to get him to learn to wish less and be more independent.
Timmy wishes that nobody needs sleep; Timmy thinks his parents would be better off without him so he wishes that he wasn't their son.
After making a deal with Dad, Crocker becomes best friends with Dinkleberg; Timmy wishes for 5,000 Timmys for the Planet of the Dads.
Timmy wishes that all the food in the world were desserts; Timmy finds that playing with dolls leads to serious trouble.
Chloe joins the Squirrely Scouts and saves the troop by helping them get their first merit badge; when Timmy and Chloe find out they have the same birthday, they decide to compete for the best party.
Timmy trades places with Cosmo and Wanda; Timmy gets into trouble when the bike he wished for becomes jealous.
60fb01a24795a6000762fe83: On the island, Lloyd learns that his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen and when the Ninja meet the playfully deceitful ruler, they realize they are in a tournament where “Only one can remain.”
In order find Zane, the Ninja stay in the tournament to get past the first round but Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole.
Chen pits everyone against each other in a ludicrous roller skating event called Thunderblade  and all contestants team up against the Ninja.
The Ninja have a secret alliance of elemental fighters, Cole has found Zane and Nya is a spy within Chen’s Kabuki to figure out what nefarious plot Chen is up to.
Nya has proof of Chen’s plan but he entices the contestants to hunt her down with promises to advance the winner, forcing the Ninja in a race to get to her first.

After stealing the remaining contestant’s powers, Chen only needs Lloyd’s power to complete the spell and knowing his daughter has feelings for Kai, Chen tries to enlist the Fire Ninja by promising to share secrets about his parents.

Chen has failed to bring the return of the Serpentine War but Clouse reveals there’s another way – his daughter has the ability to absorb the power of every fighter she comes across, so she can complete the ceremony.
The Ninja reunite with Wu and turn to the aid of a shrunken Pythor in order to figure out how to defeat the unstoppable Anacondrai.

The Ninja and fighters discover there’s a strategic location called The Corridor of Elders where they can make their last stand against Chen’s Anacondrai army... but even with the new Destiny Bounty, their forces still aren’t strong enough.

Kai promises to watch over Lloyd when Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain– but when Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission…
When Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu’s staff, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja

The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn’t keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks.
The Ninja hear of another way to learn Airjitzu - from the ghost of Sensei Yang at his haunted temple - but there’s a warning; if you are trapped in it by sunrise, you will become a ghost, too.

Now that the Ninja know Airjitzu, they get briefed about how the next stage to finding the tomb is to get ‘The Sword of Sanctuary’ from Cloud Kingdom, which can only be reached from the top of the Wailing Alps.

In Cloud Kingdom, a realm where destinies are written, the Ninja must get the Sword of Sanctuary, a powerful relic that can see past the traps surrounding the tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master – but tensions are high as Moro’s escape from the Cursed  …
The Ninja now have all the items they need to get to the tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master but before they can figure out the last riddle that leads to the location of the tomb.
The Ninja use Ronan’s airship to travel to the tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master in an underwater cave under the ocean, only to find out Moro is already there.

When Moro uses the Realm Crystal to open a portal to the Cursed Realm, ghosts take over the town - but the Ninja, in disguise, manage to get Lloyd to the center of the town and Lloyd steals the crystal…
As the ghosts converge around and mobilize the Preeminent into a hulking giant behemoth, the Ninja use Airjitzu to fight the mobile beast in an attempt to slow it down.
After the defeat of the ghosts and the destruction of the Cursed Realm, the ninja finds themselves famous all over Ninjago.
With Destiny’s Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn.

With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny’s Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot.

The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja breaks him out of jail.

Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan’s ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.

The ninja’s search for Nadakhan’s ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan’s crew is struggling to handle an airship that used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya.

Jay reveals to Cole that he made two wishes with Nadakhan. Large chunks of NINJAGO City are disappearing without a trace. The ninja find the Tiger Widow Island on the map but it is an island that exists on no other chart or database.
Jay is trapped on Nadakhan’s ship, as Nadakhan tries to force him to make his third wish. Lloyd, Cole, and Nya are marooned on Tiger Widow Island.
The ninja are trying to figure out a way to save Jay from Nadakhan’s ship. Two screenwriters, Kevin and Dan, suggest that they build a fake raid zeppelin and disguise themselves as Sky Pirates.

Jay and Nya have been holed up at the police precinct, but the Sky Pirates track him down. They flee by boat to the lighthouse where Zane’s father was once held captive. Nadakhan learns that the ninja still have the Tiger Widow venom.
LEGO Ninjago: Day of the Departed

Cole returns to Yang’s haunted temple to seek revenge on the former Airjitzu Master who turned him into a ghost, he accidentally uses a Dark Magic blade that unleashes the spectral forms of Ninjago’s greatest villains and traps himself in the temple!
Master Wu mistakenly tries to single-handedly complete a battle he began decades ago against Acronix, one of the twin Hands of Time.
The Ninja learn more about the Krux and Acronix – the two fallen Elemental Masters known as the Hands of Time – and are sure that this threat has finally been eliminated.
Kai's investigation of a Vermillion Warrior Helmet leads him to discover that Krux is alive and well in Ninjago, living under an assumed identity.
In the midst of an epidemic of mysterious metal thefts by the Vermillion Warriors, Lloyd realizes that stepping up and taking over for the ailing Master Wu is not an easy task.
While the Ninja fight to save MegaMonster Amusement Park, Jay struggles to defend his family's home from the Vermillion Warriors.

The Ninja celebrate their escape from the Vermillion Army and their retrieval of the Emerald Time Blade, but with Acronix and Krux determined to get their Blade back, the Airjitzu Temple becomes a battleground.
63fe2ec4dff38e000835f786: Rookie Blue: The One That Got Away
When a woman gets brutally attacked in the same manner as deceased rookie cop Zoe Martinelli. Det. Luke Callaghan is convinced that it’s the same suspect.
After a seemingly drunken man collapses in the barn, 15 Division is put under quarantine. Andy and Swarek work together to find the accomplice of a dyed blue bank robber
Dov and Gail work together under Swarek’s expert tutelage in a stake-out operation to stop an Asian gang from killing a snitch.
15 Division’s hunt for an armed robber leads them to the scene of a horrible car accident. While Andy deals with a woman pinned in her car, the other officers must track and apprehend the fugitive

When Traci and Andy are sent out on an undercover training exercise, they stumble upon a young woman who is about to die of an overdose. Meanwhile, Dov finds himself on a “ride-along” with a drug dealer and old friend of his deceased brother

When Gail Peck’s uniform is stolen, the rookies go after a vigilante who is impersonating a police officer. Meanwhile, Swarek’s off the grid, trying to get information out of former crime enforcer Jamie Brennan
While Swarek is brutally interrogated by Jamie Brennan in the basement of a Pickering farmhouse, the rookies help Andy solve a mystery that may reveal Swarek’s location
Rookie Blue: The First Day of the Rest of Your Life
When a mysterious young girl vanishes from the scene of a multi-car accident, Andy McNally connects the girl to a 7-year-old cold case.

As local high schools wind to a close for summer, dangerous pranks abound – including the theft of an armed police car. While tracking down the stolen vehicle, Andy and Swarek pick up the trail of a volatile teen boy
Dov Epstein happens upon a convenience store robbery-in-progress that results in him shooting a young black teenager.

On Traciʼs first day as a detective, all hell breaks loose when a carload of girls from a bachelorette party hits another vehicle, killing the driver. Jerry discovers that the driver of the parked car was dead before the accident.
While answering a domestic disturbance call, Andyʼs personal life is turned inside out when the social worker on the scene turns out to be her estranged mother
A noise complaint leads Andy and Swarek to an illegal warehouse party, and to an injured John Doe -- a homeless squatter whoʼs been stabbed in the warehouse

When a gifted psychic - or, at the very least, a gifted conman - enters 15 Division to help find the missing witness in an organized-crime case, the officers are forced to come face-to-face with some of the hidden truths

While investigating the disappearance of a grad-student-turned escort, the officers discover a pattern of missing women. Since Gail fits the physical description of the victims, she is sent on an undercover sting at a high-end hotel

After the officers of 15 Division are forced to release a suspected predator, the grim discovery of the body of a missing girl reopens an unsolved case – bringing back Detective Luke Callaghan in from the Homicide Squad to oversee it.

The officers of 15 Division are still reeling in the aftermath of the unexpected death of one of their colleagues. When they discover that a laptop has been stolen containing sensitive information, they set out to tie up several of open cases
Itʼs “back to basics” for 15 Division when Staff Sergeant Frank Best decides itʼs time for his officers to get back on track
A seasonʼs worth of trials and tribulations come to a head during a frenzied night at the station when the distracted rookies improperly search a prisoner
When a violent child abductor escapes from an emergency hospital visit, 15 Division goes on the hunt for the criminal -- only to discover that heʼs taken another young victim
65ddec1ef7f0af0008be4b65: The Dresden Files: Las reglas del compromiso
Harry descubre una desagradable alianza cuando trata de proteger a su clienta de un demonio.
Dresden se ve envuelto en una lucha territorial entre bandas de vampiros cuando le presionan para volver a saldar una deuda.
Cuando un hombre muere en la oficina de Harry, este se ve obligado a investigar una compleja trama de asesinato ligada al pasado de Bob.
Dresden acepta un caso sin cobrar después de presenciar la muerte de una mujer que le pide ayuda, pero su investigación le lleva a la magia negra y más muerte.
Dresden se enfrenta al Consejo Superior cuando sospechan que él es responsable de matar a una universitaria y a  un mafioso con magia negra.
The Dresden Files: El otro Dick
Harry debe obtener una licencia para seguir trabajando con la policía, pero cuando su profesor muere a causa de la magia negra, se alía con su ayudante en un caso que da un giro productivo.
The Dresden Files: ¿Qué pasa con Bob?
Un ligue de una noche se vuelve letal cuando un viejo enemigo de Harry reaparece.
The Dresden Files: Cosas que hacen ruidos
Morgan y la anciana Mai se cobijan en casa de Harry a regañadientes.
El padre de Murphy llega a la ciudad y saca a relucir viejos resentimientos. Cuando empieza a afectar a su investigación sobre muertes misteriosas de criminales reformados, todo va a peor.

Curtis, Kelly, Alisha y Simon aún creen que Nathan está muerto pero un misterioso hombre enmascarado lo guía a la tumba. De vuelta en el centro comunitario, Lucy aparece el día de la liberación de un ala psiquiátrica.
Jamie, el hermano de Nathan, aparece en el centro comunitario pero Nathan apenas sabe que tenía un hermano.
El hombre de la máscara aparece de nuevo justo a tiempo de salvar a Alisha de un atracador. Alisha sale para descubrir exactamente quién es este hombre misterioso pero pronto se ve superada.
Ollie, el nuevo chico, aparece para empezar sus trabajos para la sociedad y resultó ser que el también tiene un poder, ¿tomará la banda a un nuevo miembro?
No por primera vez, Nathan es violentamente asesinado. Jessica, asistente social que es todo dulzura y luz, es la principal sospechosa. Los otros están convencidos de que Simon es el próximo.
El secreto se ha revelado. Ahora, todo el mundo sabe de los superpoderes de la banda. Hay mucho para hacer con su nuevo estado de celebridad, aunque alguno los llevan mejor que otros.
El servicio a la comunidad por fin terminó. Es la semana antes de Navidad y la banda ahora está en el triste mundo laboral.
Eckhart busca un mutante que pueda absorber energía, uno con el que Brennan se involucre románticamente.
Jesse se enamora de un pirata informático, a quien Eckhart quiere "procurar" para corromper los canales de noticias informáticos públicos contra los Nuevos Mutantes ... y en beneficio de la GSA.
Un niño que está desarrollando nuevas habilidades mutantes ha sido secuestrado y el equipo accede a buscarlo para su madre. Más tarde se enteran de que fue ella quien secuestró a su hijo.
642d4493aa2d690008f0a03f: Yugi's friends are petrified into solid stone statues, but their spirits live on! Their combined souls energize Yugi into a noble fight, but is spirit going to win the duel when Yugi's not drawing the right cards?
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Das Geheimnis der Familie Kaiba
Yugi has defeated Noah... but they still can't escape from the virtual world! The real reason behind their entrapment is revealed... as is the true villain pulling the strings!

As Kaiba squares off against his stepfather Gozaburo for their final battle, Yugi and friends are attacked by endless hordes of monsters! Their only hope is Noah, but they can't expect help from their enemy... can they?

Time is almost up before the missile’s explosion destroys Yugi and friends! Will the Battle City finalists beat the clock and live to duel another day in the stunning conclusion to the virtual world saga!

Yugi and friends arrive at KaibaCorp Island where the Battle City finalists will compete in the ultimate dueling arena! Get ready for the awesome four-person battle royal where any duelist can attack anyone else!
Honor, friendship, revenge... As each duelist remembers what they’re fighting for, the battle royal rages on where none of the duelists know where the next attack is going to come from!

Joey may have fought some of the fiercest fights in Battle City, but has all his training taught him to become an elite duelist? Joey’s gonna show what he’s made of in the conclusion to the four-man battle royal!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Rückkehr ins Reich der Schatten (1)
Marik ensnares Joey in a Shadow Game where each duelist’s heart is linked with his monsters... literally! Every time a monster received damage, the duelist feels the pain instead!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Rückkehr ins Reich der Schatten (2)
Marik’s Helpoemer send Joey’s powerful cards to the graveyard before Joey can use them! Running low on cards and life points, Joey’s opportunities for staging a comeback are nearly depleted!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Rückkehr ins Reich der Schatten (3)

Joey thinks this duel can’t turn any worse... but Marik has all the pieces necessary to summon The Winged Dragon of Ra! Can Joey prevent Marik from summoning the Egyptian God Card, or is victory simply not in the cards?
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Rückkehr ins Reich der Schatten (4)

Marik transforms The Winged Dragon of Ra into its powerful form, the Egyptian God Phoenix! If Joey can’t withstand the Phoenix’s blazing fire, he’ll lose the duel... plus his only chance to save Mai from her mental prison!

It’s the rematch we’ve all been waiting for! Yugi and Kaiba square off for the first time since Duelist Kingdom in front of thousands of ravenous fans for the right to challenge Marik! It’s time to duel!
Kaiba has all the monsters necessary to summon Obelisk the Tormentor to finish Yugi off! Though overwhelmed and outmatched, nothing is going to stop Yugi from trying to summon his Egyptian God first!
When Yugi’s Slifer the Sky Dragon clashes against Kaiba’s Obelisk the Tormentor, what will happen when two Egyptian Gods fight each other? It’s time to find out which Egyptian God is truly stronger!

The clash of the two Egyptian God Monsters releases mystical energies that show Yugi and Kaiba visions of the ancient Egyptian past! What new answers do these images unlock, and what prophecies do they make for the future?

Kaiba summons three powerful Blue-Eyes White Dragons, but Yugi has no monsters remaining in his deck! Is losing only a matter of time, or will a long-dormant card from a fallen friend help turn the tide of battle?

Kaiba not only controls Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, but his Final Attack Orders card leaves Yugi with only three cards in his deck! If Yugi loses, he’ll have to give up his chance to save the world from Marik’s evil!

Tired of Kaiba’s insults, Joey challenges Kaiba for third place in the Battle City Tournament! Has Joey mastered enough strategies to take down the top dog, or is Kaiba going to wallop Joey like a pathetic puppy?
Kaiba attacks with his mighty Blue-Eyes White Dragon, but Joey has no monsters to defend with! Joey’s luck has run out, so it’s time for him to rely on skill!
Joey and Kaiba’s battle reaches its roaring climax! Will Joey take down his biggest headache and actually teach Kaiba a thing or two about being a true duelist?
It’s the critical Battle City showdown with the fate of the world at stake: Yami Yugi vs. Marik! If Yami Yugi loses, Yugi is taking a permanent vacation into the Shadow Realm!

Marik proves his The Winged Dragon of Ra is the strongest Egyptian God Card by destroying Slifer the Sky Dragon! None of Yugi’s cards can withstand its assault, but a gift from Kaiba may turn the duel around…
Yugi can’t strike Marik’s life points, and with every turn that passes, Marik is one step closer to taking down Yugi with a final strike from The Winged Dragon of Ra...
With Yugi at the end of his ropes and the maniacal Marik waging all-out war, can Marik’s oldest friend reach Marik in time to help him come to his senses before his insanity overwhelms him?

Will the combined force of all of Yugi’s monsters be enough to defeat an Egyptian God that terminated two other powerful Egyptian Gods? The fate of the world hangs in the balance with the finale of the Battle City Tournament!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Das Ende von Battle City
KaibaCorp Island is set to explode in mere minutes, but the blimp’s engines are offline! Can Yugi and friends escape from the island in time, or will they sink to the bottom of the sea?

Der heldenhafte Yugi kämpft gegen seinen Erzrivalen Kaiba in einem Abenteuer, das noch gefährlicher wird, als die imaginären Monster in ihren Spielkarten grausam real werden ... und als ein altes Übel in den Kampf eingreift.
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Kampf um die Seele - Teil 1
Yugis drei ägyptischen Götterkarten wurden gestohlen. Gurimo, der Dieb der Karten zwingt daraufhin Yugi zu einem Duell um seine Seele heraus. Zunächst behält Yugi die Oberhand.
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Kampf um die Seele - Teil 2

Obwohl Yugi als Gewinner aus dem Duell gegen Gurimo heraus ging, sind die Götterkarten nicht in seinem Deck. Die Motorradgang, um Valon, Alister und Rafael konnten die drei Karten stehlen und sind unbemerkt damit davon gekommen.
Nicht nur, dass die Welt kurz vor dessen Untergang steht, hinzu kommt das plötzliche Auftauchen einer riesigen Bestie. Um sich zu stärken, ernährt sich dieses von Menschen und Monstern.

Yugi wird von Kaiba zu einem persönlichen Gespräch eingeladen. Yugi nimmt das Angebot an, aber nur unter der Bedingung, dass seine Freunde teilnehmen dürfen. Indem Pegasus eifrig Aktien der Kaiba Cooporation kauft, zwingt er Kaiba zu einem Duell.

Kaiba nimmt die Herausforderung von Pegasus an. Jedoch verbirgt Pegasus hinter seiner Strategie ein dunkles Geheimnis. Wird Kaiba rechtzeitig hinter dieses Geheimnis kommen, bevor er im Duell gegen Pegasus seine Seele verliert?

Pegasus, der in Wirklichkeit Alister ist, kämpft im Duell gegen Kaiba mit seinen Feuerwesen. Das schwarze Magiermädchen eilt dem unterlegenen Kaiba zur Hilfe. Mit ihrer Unterstützung erscheint der mächtige Drache Critius in Kaibas Deck.

Auf dem Weg zu Industrial Illusion, dem Sitz von Pegasus, werden Joey, Tea, Tristan und Yugi von einer Motorradgang in einen Hinterhalt gelockt. Doch ein Freund kann sie aus dieser misslichen Lage in letzter Sekunde befreien.
